answer: Require each voting key to lock 100 tokens for six epochs. The ledger rejects any bond already assigned to another key and refunds it after the lock; two signatures on conflicting votes for one decision prove equivocation and burn that key's bond. N mirror accounts must lock 100N tokens simultaneously, so a gale of registrations demands proportional capital. This limits cheap vote farming, not wealthy attackers; a token-price nadir weakens the deterrent.
